run_spm_train: run the sentencepiece trainer script with command-line arguments to train a tokenizer model
run_SentencePieceTrainer_Train: run SentencePieceTrainer.Train by passing all CLI arguments as a space-separated string
create_sentencepiece_model: create a SentencePiece tokenizer model by invoking the spm_train script with input corpus and model prefix
review_spm_train: review the spm_train script that wraps SentencePieceTrainer.Train with sys.argv arguments
summarize_spm_train: summarize the spm_train script which delegates all CLI args to sentencepiece training
